newsitem.title: UK: St Paul offers UK hospitals crisis PR cover.
newsitem.headline: St Paul offers UK hospitals crisis PR cover.

text.p: St Paul International Insurance, a part of The St Paul Co, said on Friday it has added crisis pulic relations cover to its healthcare sector insurance programme for NHS Trusts in the UK.

In the event of a serious untoward incident which could produce significant media or legal interest St Paul will provide emergency press and public relations support for at least the first 48 hours following the incident, the company said in a statement.
St Paul International is the largest insurer of National Health Service (NHS) Trusts in the UK and hopes that this enhanced cover will further strengthen its position, a spokesman told Reuters.
The company also plans to increase its share of the local government insurance market over the next few years, he added.
Crisis PR cover for NHS Trusts will be provided by Clear Communication and Jonathan Street PR.
